title: Zesty Fresh Egyptian Oranges Tagine
description: A refreshing and invigorating Egyptian dish featuring the sweetness of fresh oranges, perfect for a warm day or a hangover remedy. This recipe is Jain-friendly as it doesn't include any meat or animal by-products.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the orange segments, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cinnamon.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the spice mixture to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the spice mixture to the tandoor and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Note: Traditionally, a tandoor is used for this recipe, but a conventional oven can be used as a substitute.
To cook in a conventional oven, preheat to 400°F (200°C) and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the oranges are tender.
Keep an eye on the dish while it's cooking to prevent overcooking.
Adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
The Zesty Fresh Egyptian Oranges Tagine is best served warm, but it can be served at room temperature if preferred.
